title: Verify: zustand dependency declaration and resolution unit tests
summary: Unit tests assert package.json, lockfile and import resolution for zustand.
description: Write a vitest test reading package.json and package-lock.json from disk and importing zustand. No network or app start.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, when read, then dependencies.zustand matches a semver range
Given package-lock.json, when read, then root range equals package.json and node_modules/zustand has a version
Given the import, when evaluated, then create is a function
technical_constraints: Read files with node:fs relative to the test file
definition_of_done: Test passes via the filtered command

steps.action: Create the test file. Read ../package.json with fs.readFileSync and JSON.parse; assert dependencies.zustand matches /^[\^~]?\d+\.\d+\.\d+/. Read ../package-lock.json; assert packages[''].dependencies.zustand equals the package.json value and packages['node_modules/zustand'].version is a non-empty string.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/zustandDependency.test.ts

steps.action: Add a test that does `const mod = await import('zustand')` and asserts typeof mod.create === 'function'.
steps.code: const mod = await import('zustand'); expect(typeof mod.create).toBe('function');
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/zustandDependency.test.ts
steps.expected: Import test passes; all tests in the file green.
